scope: Independent actual-pixel source comparison and independently recomputed mesh/exchange/camera/feature tests. Private QA only; no main-repository edit or publication authorization.
source_view_method: Actual stored pixels personally viewed. Review derivatives are faithful local reductions/crops of originals, not generated images. view_reviews.finding: Distinct wave/faceted facade, right broad-and-narrow glazing core with white upper return and slots, dissimilar end masses and setback sixth floor visible. Corrected V2 no longer reduces glazed core to a thin strip.

Straight window ribbons, brown two-storey lower frames, raised open entrance pergola and actual recessed ground entry visible. Stair short-end solid wall and true openings, central high box/low curved roof and separated PV levels retained.

Six principal levels plus local roof additions, not a uniform seventh floor. Front wave rhythm and different end treatment retained. Height/width remains disclosed photo-relative approximation, not a calibrated measurement.

Separated PV groups at different roof levels, lower shallow curved metal roof next to higher white block, front low core terrace and exterior stair negative spaces visible. No neighboring building or fictional symmetric wing.
Curved landing guards and actual diagonal stair runs remain open while restored short-end white wall has lower triangular and upper rectangular openings; not a completely bare skeletal stair.

required_v1_changes_resolved.resolution: Restored broad short-end wall, actual lower triangular and upper rectangular cutouts, maintained front stair openness and curved guards.
Restored wider paired major window banks and intervening solid division; neighboring narrow recess remains distinct.
Raised pergola to approximately two-storey relation and cut ground-level body recess with full-height opaque door and low landing/steps; generic ground window band cleared.
Widened main glazing, separate narrow strip, upper curved/faceted white cap with three narrow glazing proxies and low open terrace.

approximation_limits: No measured plans/elevations: dimensions, global proportions, roof curvature, recess sizes, fine window/mullion counts, PV panel/support details remain photo-relative estimates.
Roof masses/negative-space relationships, not panel grid count, are the binding features. Six model PV groups are an appearance representation, not a certified module inventory.
Opaque glazing and solid interiors; no hidden rooms, underground structure, or reconstructed equipment.
Display base is not measured terrain. Stair/roof/PV edges and supports are thickened; finite mesh probes are not global thickness proof.
PV attached surface relief nominally 0.35 mm may not print with common nozzles; overhangs require orientation/support/material assessment.
720-section and strict exchange results do not establish physical print success or support-free printability. No physical print test claimed.
